description: US Treasury yields as JSON, no API key: the daily par yield curve (1M to 30Y), real yields (TIPS), T-bill rates and long-term rates, with 10Y-2Y, 10Y-3M, 30Y-5Y and 2Y-3M spreads, an inversion flag, day-over-day change in basis points and full history since 1990. Modes: latest, one date (nearest previous business day on holidays), history range (daily, weekly or monthly), spreads, and inversion periods. Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury (public domain). Monitor mode returns only new business days. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.001 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/treasury-yields-api.

curve.description: nominal = daily par yield curve (1M-30Y, since 1990); real = real yield curve / TIPS (5Y-30Y, since 2003); bills = T-bill bank discount and coupon equivalent rates (since 2002); longterm = long-term composite and 20Y CMT (since 2000). Sprea

date.description: For mode date: the day you want, YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2024-03-15.

endDate.description: For history, spreads and inversion: last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

frequency.description: For history and spreads: daily (every business day), weekly (last business day of each week) or monthly (last business day of each month).

limit.description: Maximum rows returned (newest kept when the range is longer). Between 1 and 20000.

maturities.description: Optional filter, for example 2Y, 10Y, 3M, 30Y. Empty = every maturity of the curve.

mode.description: latest = the newest yield curve; date = one day (a holiday or weekend returns the previous business day and says so); history = every business day between Start and End date; spreads = spread time series only; inversion = periods when 10Y-2

startDate.description: For history, spreads and inversion: first day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 30 days before End date. Max range 40 years.
